reviews.evidence: Added the complete topological definition for an arbitrary base: continuous surjection, real vector-space fibers, rank-r local homeomorphisms to U x R^r, and fiberwise linearity. Smoothness is explicitly excluded from the core; bundle maps, pullbacks, and examples are separated into later sections. The listed topology, product, linear-algebra, and linear-isomorphism targets supply the defining structures.

Added the complete relative construction for a pair A subset X: quotient singular chain groups, induced boundary, coefficient-valued relative cochains, coboundary, and the kernel modulo image definition of H^n(X,A;G). Maps of pairs, the ordinary-cohomology special case, and the long exact sequence are stated after the core. The topology, singular-chain, abelian-group, cohomology, and cochain-complex targets supply the defining structures.
